name: @obsidian-plugin-toolkit/sidebar-guard
description: Cmd/Ctrl+W and next/previous tab never act on a sidebar panel (Claudian, Outline, Backlinks…): with one active they close or switch your tabs in the main area instead, as in VS Code. Notes opened in a sidebar still close as usual.
author: yeyan1996
